source: query-phrasing workflow, run 44814420665 (DataForSEO, BR market, pt)
method: Each text names the observed phrasings it follows. 'observed': people type that form; 'adapted': the form is observed but reworded so the slot works for any noun, masculine or feminine, a person or a place, singular; 'unsupported': no query in the data. Words that agree with the noun are written as groups, masculine first ('{um bom|uma boa}').
